summary_html:
No matching published aggressive prostate cancer baseline is available. These saved summaries use the HR ≈ RR ≈ OR identity approximation; provide incidence in Settings for baseline-dependent calculations.

headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger’s test is generally not recommended when fewer than 10 studies are available.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 2 studies yielded an effect size of 0.86 (95% CI: 0.63–1.17), indicating no statistically significant association between total dietary fiber intake and aggressive prostate cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by substantial heterogeneity (I² = 51.20%), reflecting considerable variability across studies.
